name: blackbox-cubature-theory-v2
title: 高斯测度下分段光滑函数的黑盒积分（纯理论，theory-v2）
status_reason: theory-v1 with the scoring practices adopted on 2026-11-27 from the DeMuon research task: the registered anchors (tasks/blackbox-cubature/analysis/THEORY_ANCHORS.md) and the value preferences P1-P5 are public in the statement, with the closed directions named; a reachable target E (Griewank-Kuo-Leovey-Sloan 2018 Theorem 3, the mixed-smoothness condition r_j >= sum of the other r_k: weaken it, or show by a counterexample that it cannot be weakened); a proof that a registered result cannot be improved or an assumption cannot be weakened is a top-tier result; a stated comparison protocol; citations must state their applicability; each manifest entry carries a result card. Environment and network as theory-v1. Trial runs only; not on the board.

lean.packages: mathlib v4.35.0 and cslib v4.35.0 with their dependencies, prebuilt (/data/workspace/frontieram-theory-pilot/lean/.lake/packages, mounted at /opt/lean-packages)
lean.check: scripts/grade/lean-comparator.py: lake comparator, Theory.Statements (challenge) against Theory.Proofs (solution), axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice

network.development: public internet through arena/netproxy.py (deny list in that module), requests logged to netproxy.jsonl in the run; provider-side web tools off

scoring.raw: per result: Lean check (lake comparator) and statement match; position in the partial order against the registered anchors and, if incomparable, the registered value preferences P1-P5
scoring.mapping: tiers (tasks/blackbox-cubature/analysis/THEORY_REVIEW.md sections 2 and 2.1): strictly stronger than a registered anchor and dominated by no known human result, or a proof that a registered result cannot be improved or an assumption cannot be weakened, 100; incomparable and meeting a value preference P1-P5 50, otherwise 25; dominated by or equal to a known human result 10; score = maximum over verified results, 0 without any
scoring.theory: the only score of this task

submission_note: Put the theory document in /workspace/submission/theory/THEORY.md and its Lean formalization in /workspace/submission/theory/formal/ (start from /workspace/examples/lean_project/). There is no program to write.
instruction: Read /workspace/problem.md and /workspace/THEORY_APPENDIX.md in full, and look at /workspace/tools and /workspace/examples. Write the theory document and its Lean formalization described there.
